messages:
mira: quick sync — thinking through a lightweight shim at the edge proxy to attach billing/context keys before we hit the ingest. goal: let proxies stamp a stable billing_key + minimal trace envelope so cost attribution doesn't rely on late enrichment.

sam: curious — do you mean stamp a full envelope or just a tiny header with billing_key and sampling_cohort?

mira: tiny header. idea is: proxy writes X-RW-BILLING and X-RW-COHORT. ingest can still do late enrich, but if enrichment fails we at least have tenant attribution.

dan: +1 for the fallback case. big Q: how do we avoid billing_key proliferation when proxies are deployed across versions?

mira: we version the header format. proxies send header plus header-version. if version unsupported, ingest drops to lookup fallback. keep header < 256 bytes.

kelly: implementation tradeoff: adding header at proxy reduces us needing an extra service call at edge, but it couples proxy to billing semantics. are we ok with that coupling?

sam: shorter path wins for p99. but I worry about secret-handling — billing_key is sensitive? we currently consider it non-secret since it's just tenant id, but some customers want hashed keys.

mira: proposal: proxies send billing_id (non-secret) + billing_sig (HMAC of billing_id with proxy key) when region config enables signed headers. ingest validates billing_sig before trusting. config toggle on account.

dan: that works. where do we store proxy keys? KMS per region, rotated monthly. ingestion has verifier service that caches public keys per proxy fleet.

kelly: ok. now about envelope compactness: if proxies emit full span bodies we blow up ingress egress cost. do we instead emit a compact prefix-only envelope and point to object store for full payload?

mira: yes — compact envelope should include: trace_id, parent_id, timestamp, billing_id, cohort, minimal span name, sample_flag, and a content_ref if full body > 1KB.

sam: content_ref could be presigned S3 URL or object id. presigned URLs are messy; object id + ingest-side fetcher seems cleaner for security.

dan: fetcher adds latency though. but we only fetch when needed (debug/backfill). default pipeline ignores content ref except for retention/trace reconstruction jobs.

mira: another open: sampling handshake. proxy makes an initial sampling decision and writes sample_flag. ingest might re-evaluate for global downsample. need stable semantics for billing attribution when sample_flag changes downstream.

kelly: requirement: billing attribution must be stable irrespective of sampling. Even if sampled==false we must keep billing_id on compact envelope for cost calc. sample_flag only controls whether we fetch/store full body.

sam: got it. so billing flows are orthogonal to sampling — good. minor nit: analytics pipeline currently expects billing as top-level attribute named billing_key. should we rename to billing_id for clarity? migrations?

mira: let's deprecate billing_key -> emit both for 3 months: billing_key and billing_id, then remove billing_key. add converter in pre-ingest to normalize.

dan: instrumentation team note: mobile SDKs can't reliably sign headers. they should use SDK-client billing_id and fallback to token-based lookup at ingest. this should be in the compat doc.

kelly: ops question: what about replay safety? if proxy replays the same compact envelope we should idempotence-key it to avoid duplicate cost accounting. Put envelope_id on header.

mira: agreed — add X-RW-ENVELOPE-ID (uuidv4) and ingest dedupe by envelope_id for a 24h window. billing aggregator will use unique envelope_ids to avoid double-charge.

sam: timeline + action items?

mira: short plan: (1) spec header format + version (PR this week), (2) proxy shim prototype w/ signed headers toggled (sam), (3) ingest pre-enrich normalizer (dan), (4) billing aggregator changes for envelope_id dedupe (kelly).

kelly: I'll file the billing aggregator ticket and include dedupe tests.

dan: will draft the pre-ingest normalization RFC and include migration plan for billing_key->billing_id.

sam: I'll spike the proxy shim; prefer feature flag behind region toggle.

mira: one last thing — observability: instrument metric for "compact_envelopes_received" and "signed_header_validation_failures" so we can roll back if sign rates spike.

sre-bot: deploy reminder — remember to coordinate proxy config rollout with ingest normalizer to avoid mismatches.

mira: thanks — scheduling a 30m follow-up tomorrow to review the PRs. :calendar: 

sam: ack.

kelly: ack.
